name: pick_place_bread
instruction: pick up the bread and put it in its bin

success.rubric: The bread is inside its own bin, resting on the bin floor, with the gripper released. Landing in a neighbouring bin does not count.

metadata.placement: This environment builds its own object layout and discards any given to it, so the start regions here describe the task for a real bench and do not drive the simulator. Runs in it are noted accordingly.
